objective: T-20260929-34: individual-stock, synthetic-2x-leveraged, concentrated (top 1-3), point-in-time-megacap-menu version of S3's 63-day-momentum/vt40 mechanism -- K1/K2 keep-tier screen plus a stock-picking increment test against an equal-weight control and a random-pick placebo.

sources.core_claim: Daily-reset leveraged/inverse ETFs typically unsuitable beyond one session; compounding can sharply diverge long-run performance from the stated daily objective, magnified by volatility.
sources.project_applicability: Direct motivation for the vt40 overlay and monthly rebalance on the synthetic L2_ series.
sources.reflection: Pre-dates single-stock LETFs (2022); general, not single-stock-specific -- read as a mechanism warning, not a single-stock-specific finding.

sources.core_claim: Reg T gives 2x overnight leverage; Alpaca margin interest 5.00-6.50%/year on end-of-day debit balance; >=70%-concentrated single-security positions face a 50% maintenance margin rate above $100k balance.
sources.project_applicability: Grounds fin_d=2.5%/year as conservative vs Alpaca's real rate; flags the k=1 concentration-margin rule as an execution-feasibility caveat for a promotion-stage review.
sources.reflection: Single source, not cross-checked against a second Alpaca page this session; rates can change.

sources.core_claim: A 10-long/10-short concentrated momentum book: CAGR 32%, max drawdown -88.09%, OOS performance slightly negative.
sources.project_applicability: Quantitative evidence concentration inflates tail risk beyond this project's drawdown gate; motivates reporting max_dd for every candidate.
sources.reflection: Long-short 10/10, unlevered, no explicit cost model -- not this iteration's exact design; still the closest quantitative concentration-risk data point found.

sources.core_claim: Momentum strategies experience infrequent, forecastable crash clusters in panic states following market declines and high volatility.
sources.project_applicability: Academic grounding for the tail-risk mechanism a concentrated+leveraged momentum book magnifies; motivates explicit stress-window and max-drawdown reporting.
sources.reflection: Broad long-short factor construction, not this iteration's long-only top-k megacap-menu design; read for the mechanism, not a direct backtest analog.

sources.core_claim: 10-stock sector-neutral momentum: Sharpe 0.59 vs 0.38 equal-weighted; sub-10-name concentration statistically monotonic-positive on average but universe-dependent/noisy per realization.
sources.project_applicability: Closest on-topic academic evidence for the k=1..3 question; direct motivation for the equal-weight control and random-pick placebo.
sources.reflection: SSRN full text blocked (403 curl and WebFetch); claim rests on a WebSearch snippet, not the read primary text -- same handling as the h20260929_10 iteration's own blocked-SSRN precedent.

sources.core_claim: Standard LETF expected-return disclosure methods materially mis-state true long-run expected return once realized-vol regime is accounted for; error magnified at higher leverage.
sources.project_applicability: Grounds reporting actual simulated backtest output rather than a formula-projected 2x scaling; supports relying on the vt40 overlay as the risk control.
sources.reflection: WebFetch returned 403; claim rests on a WebSearch snippet, not the read full text.

sources.core_claim: Single-stock leveraged/inverse ETFs flagged as materially more volatility-drag-prone than index-level leveraged ETFs.
sources.project_applicability: Regulator-level caution specific to the single-stock-leverage mechanism this iteration synthesizes; supports restricting the universe to the liquid megacap menu.
sources.reflection: Policy statement, not an empirical study; the volatility-drag claim in the summary is asserted rather than independently derived from a dataset in the statement.

sources.core_claim: Unlevered top-37 concentrated momentum, broad top-500: K1 fails (anchor 1.03 vs 1.19, stress 0.51 vs 0.65); K2 fails (-0.143/-0.071 vs >=0.05).
sources.project_applicability: Closest prior local test of the stock-picking mechanism; sets a cautious prior for this narrower/leveraged design, and directly informs the falsification controls preregistered here.
sources.reflection: Different k (37 vs 1-3), universe construction and no leverage/vt40 -- treated as adjacent evidence, not a direct repeat, per direction-review.json's existing_solution_comparison.

sources.core_claim: Leveraged single-asset SMA trend-gate family refuted; calendar-shift placebo beat the real signal in 100% of holdout seeds.
sources.project_applicability: Adjacent negative evidence that leveraged single-instrument exposure has repeatedly failed this project's own placebo tests; direct motivation for the random-pick placebo and equal-weight control.
sources.reflection: Different mechanism (SMA trend gate, not momentum ranking) and instruments (existing leveraged index ETFs, not synthetic single-stock).

candidate_matrix_revisions.effect: Kept the brief's own preregistered controls (equal-weight-no-picking top-20/2x/vt40, and a deterministic random-pick top-20/k=2/2x/vt40 placebo) as hard falsification gates -- any of the 12 mechanism cells that appears to clear K1/K2 must still beat both controls on judged anchor Sharpe, so a leverage-and-vol-target-driven Sharpe bump cannot be mistaken for a stock-picking edge.
